state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 9 (the AD extras) is under way**: sort and a VLV window are on `main`, and `sort_and_a_vlv_window_return_the_requested_slice` passes against `samba-ad`. Stages 1 to 5, 7 and 8 are done. Stage 4 is done except for a CA that a program supplies. Stage 6 is done except wiring the schema into the readers. Stage 9's deleted objects, DirSync and the Global Catalog are not written.

**On `main`**: everything Stage 8 listed, plus `nvs_ldap::Sort` and `nvs_ldap::Window` as `SearchRequest` fields, `Control::sort`, `Control::window` and `Control::window_total` (`crates/nvs-ldap/src/proto.rs`), and a `Cursor` that sends a window in place of paging and keeps the server's count as `Cursor::total` (`crates/nvs-ldap/src/conn.rs` module doc, "A window is one answer"). `search` takes `sort`, `descending`, `offset` and `window`, and `Ldap\Entries::total(): ?int` reads a fifth slot written when the search starts. ADR 0278 § 1 wrote `window: {offset, count}`; an option bag cannot hold a shape, so it is two flat options, and `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs`'s module doc records why. `tests/conformance/core/ldap-search-window-agrees-with-a-sorted-search.nvst` pins it from Novis.

Server cases reach `samba-ad` (`tests/db/compose.yaml`) at `ldaps://localhost:16636`, and plain LDAP at 16389. Write cases add and delete their own entries under names no other case uses: OUs `Shop`/`Blog`/`Store`/`Framework`/`Example`/`Catalog`/`Library`/`Gallery`/`Studio`/`Archive` at the root, and each test user `CN=<name>,OU=<name>` in an OU of its own (`Team`, `Editors`, `Visitors`, `Members`, `Readers` in Rust; `Staff`, `Authors`, `Owners`, `Clients` in cases). Grep the name across `tests/conformance/core/ldap-*.nvst` and `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ldap.rs` before taking one.

items.text: **Deleted objects** (ADR 0278 § 11): `showDeleted` (`.417`) as a search option beside `window` in `SEARCH_OPTIONS` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:298`, sent the way `Cursor::new` adds the sort control at `crates/nvs-ldap/src/conn.rs:724`, and `Entry::isDeleted` reading `isDeleted`. Closes `show_deleted_finds_a_deleted_entry`.

**DirSync since a cookie** (ADR 0278 § 11): `changes(Filter, ?ChangesOptions): Changes` and `Changes::cookie()`, a `.841` control beside `VLV_RESPONSE` at `crates/nvs-ldap/src/proto.rs:32`, read the way `Cursor::fetch` reads a window at `crates/nvs-ldap/src/conn.rs:848`. On a server without DirSync it throws `Unsupported`. Closes `dirsync_returns_only_what_changed_since_its_cookie` and `tests/conformance/core/ldap-sync-cookie.nvst`.

**A write to a Global Catalog block throws before it is sent** (ADR 0278 § 11): a URL on port 3268 or 3269 is read-only. The writes start at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/write.rs:59`, and nothing in `crates/nvs-config/src/ldap.rs` marks a block as a Global Catalog yet. Closes `a_write_to_a_global_catalog_block_throws_before_it_is_sent`.

backlog: The readers take the base type from the schema (`rule:core-classes/ldap-value-types`), Stage 6's last item; `crate::ldap::schema` is at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs`.
A CA that a program supplies to `Ldap::open` (Stage 4's remainder; `tls_ca_file: None` in `nvs_core_ldap_open`).
Stage 10, the feature proofs: `bun nv proofs --id 'Core\Ldap'` lists what each class owes, `authenticate`, `sort` and `total()` included.
A run against a Windows Server evaluation VM is the user's to do by hand (`docs/agent/goals/ldap.md`); AD's own VLV and sort limits are only checked there.
